sources.name: World Health Organization
sources.credibility_note: Primary source for global health guidance, disease surveillance, and international health statistics. Check the publication date, population, and stated limitations.

sources.name: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.credibility_note: Primary source for US public health guidance and surveillance. Guidance can be jurisdiction-specific and may change; check dates and cited studies.

sources.name: National Health Service
sources.credibility_note: Primary source for UK patient guidance and health-service information. Not a substitute for clinical advice; check local applicability and review dates.

sources.name: Reuters
sources.credibility_note: Established wire service with editorial sourcing standards and a dedicated fact-check desk. For consequential claims, follow links to primary records and independent corroboration.

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.credibility_note: Established wire service with editorial sourcing standards and a dedicated fact-check desk. Distinguish reported facts from analysis and verify claims against primary records.

sources.name: FactCheck.org
sources.credibility_note: Publishes sourced reviews of US political claims. Review the cited source material, scope, and publication date rather than relying on the verdict label alone.

sources.name: Full Fact
sources.credibility_note: Publishes evidence-linked fact checks, primarily on UK public-interest claims. Check the evidence, geographic scope, and date for relevance.

sources.name: Snopes
sources.credibility_note: Investigates viral claims and rumors with cited material. Read the full analysis and cited sources; a rating may address only part of a broad claim.

sources.name: Nature
sources.credibility_note: Publishes peer-reviewed research and science reporting. A single study is not a scientific consensus; distinguish research articles from news and commentary.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.credibility_note: Indexes biomedical literature, including studies with different methods and evidence quality. Indexing is not an endorsement; inspect study design, publication type, and later reviews.

sources.name: Our World in Data
sources.credibility_note: Provides documented datasets and analysis with source links. Check definitions, underlying data, update dates, and methodological notes.
